text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: High 5xx rate on gateway-prod (PGR-5482). 5xx > 2% over 5m. Alerting on-call.

olivia: I'm looking at the dashboards now. Frontend latency + token tail looks normal, but batching scheduler queue depth spiked from ~200 to ~6200 in 3m.

raj: I can repro on staging. Scheduler backlog shows head-of-line blocking: one long-running batch from tenant t-42 (seq_len=4096) blocking others.

melissa: CS: enterprise customers alpha / beta / gamma reporting timeouts ~30s and errors. They're escalating.

oncall-ryan: Taking this. Paging infra, looking at autoscaling, and checking scheduler pods. ETA 2m.

sre-lee: Logs show many requests hitting worker timeouts and then gateway 502s. Sample trace:
```
2026-08-12T21:12:03Z scheduler ERROR worker.go:178 timeout waiting for model response (30s)
2026-08-12T21:12:04Z gateway WARN proxy.go:204 upstream reset by peer
```

opsbot: Quick mitigation jobs available: `bypass-batching` feature toggle present. Recommend enabling for small requests while we triage.

olivia: I'm going to isolate tenant t-42 to its own lane (bypass batching for that tenant) to break the HOL. Applying policy now.

raj: Command I'm running on the scheduler cluster:
```
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/scheduler -c control -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s localhost:8080/debug/queue | jq . | grep t-42"
```
Output snippet:
```
{"tenant":"t-42","queue_depth":4160,"avg_batch_wait_ms":11240}
```

melissa: Notifying affected accounts and setting expectation: mitigation may temporarily increase latency for large requests.

oncall-ryan: Also changing HOL eviction timer from 10s -> 4s and lowering `max_batch_size` for default pool to reduce blocking. Applying; rolling restart schedulers (3 pods).

opsbot: Change accepted: HOL eviction=4s, max_batch_size default=64. Rolling restart triggered (pod restarts 1/3 -> 3/3).

incident-bot: 10m check-in: 5xx rate trending down, queue depth decreased.

olivia: After mitigations: scheduler queue depth now ~1.1k, tenant t-42 backlog 0, overall 5xx at 0.6% -> below threshold. Gateway 502s have stopped.

customer-success-jamie: CS confirms two customers report recovery, third still had a single error but now cleared. Will follow up with account reps.

sre-lee: Root cause hypothesis: long-tail large-sequence requests from t-42 created oversized batches that monopolized GPU workers and KV cache warming, causing HOL blocking and timeouts. Contributing factor: autoscaler didn't spin up additional workers fast enough due to conservative CPU-based scaling.

oncall-ryan: Handoff to eng-runtime for deep postmortem and follow-up items. Pager cleared at 21:54 UTC. Actions assigned:
- INF-3219: add per-tenant queue spikes telemetry and alerting
- INF-3220: add tenant isolation runbook + automated bypass toggle
- INF-3221: revisit autoscale policy for scheduler (incorporate queue depth and GPU metrics)
- INF-3222: evaluate default HOL eviction and batch sizing

olivia: Filing INF-3219/3220/3221/3222 now. Thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed. Duration ~42m. Primary mitigations: tenant bypass, HOL eviction tuning, rolling restart. Postmortem scheduled for next-week.
